text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has assessed an appeal from the owner of 266 Waverley Road for front yard parking. Front yard parking at this location is not recommended because it does not meet the criteria of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 918 in that the Code does not permit the licensing of a front yard parking pad where on-street permit parking is authorized on the same side of the street and the installation of a permanent ramp to service the proposed parking pad would result in the loss of a permit parking space. Additionally, the Code does not permit the licensing of a front yard parking pad where the required clearance from a city tree cannot be provided. The owner will be given an opportunity to make a deputation before Community Council.
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred the item indefinitely.
